```{shinylive-r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(shiny))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(bslib))

# ── Palette dei trattamenti ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Le stesse di CleanRhizo.
# npg: ggsci::pal_npg() (Nature Publishing Group), molto usata in figure di biologia.
# okabe: Okabe-Ito senza il nero, distinguibile con deficit della visione dei colori.
# gray: generata sul numero di trattamenti, per la stampa in bianco e nero. Si ferma
# a 0.7 (non 0.85 come in CleanRhizo): qui i colori sono linee su sfondo bianco.
# Oltre il numero di colori disponibili, npg e okabe ricominciano dall'inizio.
PALETTES <- list(
  npg   = c("#E64B35","#4DBBD5","#00A087","#3C5488","#F39B7F",
            "#8491B4","#91D1C2","#DC0000","#7E6148","#B09C85"),
  okabe = c("#E69F00","#56B4E9","#009E73","#F0E442",
            "#0072B2","#D55E00","#CC79A7","#999999")
)
DEFAULT_PALETTE <- "npg"

get_palette <- function(name, n) {
  base <- if (identical(name, "gray")) gray.colors(max(n, 1), start = 0.2, end = 0.7)
          else if (!is.null(PALETTES[[name]])) PALETTES[[name]]
          else PALETTES[[DEFAULT_PALETTE]]
  rep_len(adjustcolor(base, alpha.f = 0.8), n)
}

# ── Colonne di metadati ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
META_COLS     <- c("unit","timestamp","sensor","genotype","g_alias","treatment",
                   "date","posA","posX","posY")
ID_COLS_DAILY <- c("unit","date","treatment","posX","posY","genotype","n_scans")
# Etichetta per i vasi senza trattamento: "" non può fare da nome di un colore
NO_TREATMENT  <- "(none)"
# Unità riconosciute nell'ultima parola del nome di un parametro
UNIT_TOKENS   <- c("nm","mm","cm","dm","m","mm2","cm2","dm2","m2","mm3","cm3","dm3","m3",
                   "mm\u00b2","cm\u00b2","dm\u00b2","m\u00b2","mm\u00b3","cm\u00b3","dm\u00b3","m\u00b3",
                   "g","mg","kg","\u00b5g","\u00b0","deg","px")
param_unit <- function(p) {
  p   <- trimws(p)
  tok <- gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", sub("^.*\\s", "", p))
  if (grepl("\\s", p) && tok %in% UNIT_TOKENS) tok else ""
}

# ── Date: ISO o formati europei, anche con l'ora in coda ─────────────────────
parse_pe_date <- function(x) {
  s  <- trimws(as.character(x)); ok <- !is.na(s) & nzchar(s)
  fmts <- c("%Y-%m-%d","%Y/%m/%d","%d/%m/%Y","%d.%m.%Y","%d-%m-%Y","%m/%d/%Y")
  read_fmt <- function(f) {
    d <- as.Date(rep(NA, length(s)))
    d[ok] <- as.Date(s[ok], format = f)
    y <- as.integer(format(d, "%Y"))
    d[!is.na(y) & (y < 1990 | y > 2100)] <- NA
    d
  }
  # Vale il formato che legge più righe: una data rovinata non scarta tutto il file
  parsed <- lapply(fmts, read_fmt)
  n_ok   <- vapply(parsed, function(d) sum(!is.na(d)), 0L)
  best   <- which.max(n_ok)
  list(date = parsed[[best]],
       ambiguous = fmts[best] == "%d/%m/%Y" && n_ok[best] > 0 &&
                   n_ok[fmts == "%m/%d/%Y"] == n_ok[best])
}

# ── Parsing PlantEye ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
parse_planteye <- function(filepath) {
  # Tutto come testo: read.csv altrimenti trasforma i metadati (T/F -> TRUE/FALSE,
  # 01 -> 1, NA -> mancante). I parametri diventano numeri in fase di aggregazione.
  df <- read.csv(filepath, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 encoding = "UTF-8", colClasses = "character", na.strings = character(0))
  # File non UTF-8 (es. Latin-1 salvato da Excel)
  to_utf8 <- function(x) {
    bad <- !validUTF8(x)
    if (any(bad)) x[bad] <- iconv(x[bad], "latin1", "UTF-8")
    x
  }
  names(df) <- to_utf8(names(df))
  df[] <- lapply(df, to_utf8)
  # BOM UTF-8 all'inizio del file (byte EF BB BF, anche se letto come "ï»¿")
  b1 <- charToRaw(names(df)[1])
  for (bom in list(as.raw(c(0xef,0xbb,0xbf)), as.raw(c(0xc3,0xaf,0xc2,0xbb,0xc2,0xbf))))
    if (length(b1) > length(bom) && all(b1[seq_along(bom)] == bom))
      names(df)[1] <- rawToChar(b1[-seq_along(bom)])
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
  miss <- setdiff(c("unit","timestamp","treatment"), names(df))
  if (length(miss)) stop("ERR_COLS|", paste(miss, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  for (m in intersect(META_COLS, names(df))) df[[m]] <- trimws(df[[m]])
  for (m in c("unit","timestamp")) df[[m]][df[[m]] == "NA"] <- ""
  df$treatment[!nzchar(df$treatment)] <- NO_TREATMENT
  pd <- parse_pe_date(df$timestamp)
  df$date <- pd$date
  if (all(is.na(df$date))) stop("ERR_DATE", call. = FALSE)
  n_bad <- sum(is.na(df$date))
  df <- df[!is.na(df$date) & nzchar(df$unit), , drop = FALSE]
  parts  <- strsplit(df$unit, ":")
  getpos <- function(i) suppressWarnings(as.integer(vapply(parts,
              function(p) if (length(p) >= 3) p[i] else NA_character_, "")))
  df$posX <- getpos(2); df$posY <- getpos(3)
  if (!nrow(df) || any(is.na(df$posX) | is.na(df$posY))) stop("ERR_UNIT", call. = FALSE)
  df$posA <- vapply(parts, function(p) p[1], "")
  attr(df, "pe_notes") <- list(bad_dates = n_bad, ambiguous = pd$ambiguous)
  df
}

# ── Classificazione parametri ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
classify_params <- function(df) {
  all_p  <- setdiff(colnames(df), META_COLS)
  is_dist <- grepl("\\[.+\\]", all_p)
  list(main = all_p[!is_dist], dist = all_p[is_dist], all = all_p)
}

# ── Aggregazione giornaliera per pianta ───────────────────────────────────────
# Unità sperimentale = vaso (unit). Tutte le scansioni dello stesso vaso nello
# stesso giorno (ripetizioni nel giorno e, con più teste, i diversi sensori)
# sono repliche tecniche: si ottiene sempre UNA riga per pianta e giorno.
daily_mean_per_plant <- function(df, params) {
  params <- params[params %in% colnames(df)]
  key    <- paste(df$unit, format(df$date), sep = "\r")
  first  <- !duplicated(key)
  info   <- intersect(c("unit","date","treatment","posX","posY","genotype"), colnames(df))
  out    <- df[first, info, drop = FALSE]
  grp    <- factor(key, levels = key[first])
  out$n_scans <- as.integer(table(grp))
  for (p in params) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[p]]))
    out[[p]] <- as.numeric(tapply(v, grp, function(x)
      if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  }
  out <- out[order(out$date, out$posX, out$posY), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

# Valori presenti ma non numerici (es. decimale con la virgola), che diventano NA
count_non_numeric <- function(df, params) {
  params <- params[params %in% colnames(df)]
  n <- vapply(params, function(p) {
    s <- trimws(as.character(df[[p]]))
    sum(nzchar(s) & !(toupper(s) %in% c("NA","NAN")) &
          is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s))))
  }, 0L)
  n[n > 0]
}

# ── Aggregazione media±SE per trattamento × giorno ───────────────────────────
agg_trt_day <- function(daily_df, params, selected_units) {
  sub <- daily_df[daily_df$unit %in% selected_units, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(sub)) return(NULL)
  result <- list()
  for (p in params) {
    vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub[[p]]))
    if (all(is.na(vals))) next
    tmp  <- sub; tmp$val <- vals
    m    <- aggregate(val ~ date + treatment, data = tmp, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    s    <- aggregate(val ~ date + treatment, data = tmp, FUN = function(x) {
      n <- sum(!is.na(x)); if (n < 2) 0 else sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n)
    })
    nn   <- aggregate(val ~ date + treatment, data = tmp, FUN = function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
    names(m)[3] <- "mean"; names(s)[3] <- "se"; names(nn)[3] <- "n"
    merged <- merge(merge(m, s, by = c("date","treatment")), nn, by = c("date","treatment"))
    merged$param <- p
    result[[p]] <- merged
  }
  if (!length(result)) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, result)
}

# ── Colori trattamento (palette npg condivisa) ────────────────────────────────
make_trt_colors <- function(treatments, palette = DEFAULT_PALETTE) {
  trts <- sort(unique(as.character(treatments)))
  setNames(get_palette(palette, length(trts)), trts)
}

# Testo leggibile sul vaso: scuro sui colori chiari (giallo, grigi chiari).
# I colori sono semitrasparenti, quindi conta anche lo sfondo della mappa.
label_color <- function(col, bg = "#FFFFFF") {
  m <- col2rgb(col, alpha = TRUE)[, 1] / 255
  v <- m[1:3] * m[4] + (col2rgb(bg)[, 1] / 255) * (1 - m[4])
  lin <- ifelse(v <= 0.03928, v / 12.92, ((v + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
  if (sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * lin) > 0.45) "#1A1A1A" else "#FFFFFF"
}

# ── Generazione SVG mappa bench ──────────────────────────────────────────────
make_bench_svg <- function(map_df, trt_colors, selected_units,
                            cell_w = 60, cell_h = 60,
                            pad_x = 52, pad_y = 44, legend_h = 40,
                            is_dark = FALSE, bench_label = "Bench") {
  fg     <- if (is_dark) "#D8E8D5" else "#374151"
  bg     <- if (is_dark) "#1E261D" else "#FFFFFF"
  n_col  <- max(map_df$posX)
  svg_w  <- n_col * cell_w + pad_x * 2
  rx     <- 10
  # Valori diversi di "a" in a:x:y possono riusare le stesse coordinate:
  # ogni "a" ha il suo blocco, altrimenti i vasi si sovrappongono
  benches <- unique(map_df$posA)
  benches <- benches[order(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(benches)), benches)]
  title_h <- if (length(benches) > 1) 24 else 0

  cells <- character(0)
  y_top <- 0
  for (b in benches) {
    md    <- map_df[map_df$posA == b, , drop = FALSE]
    n_row <- max(md$posY)
    if (title_h > 0) cells <- c(cells, sprintf(
      '<text x="%.0f" y="%.0f" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="%s" font-family="system-ui">%s %s</text>',
      pad_x, y_top + 16, fg, bench_label, htmltools::htmlEscape(b)))
    y0 <- y_top + title_h + pad_y

    # Etichette assi
    for (x in seq_len(n_col)) {
      cx <- pad_x + (x-1)*cell_w + cell_w/2
      cells <- c(cells, sprintf(
        '<text x="%.0f" y="%.0f" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="%s" font-family="system-ui">%d</text>',
        cx, y0 - 8, fg, x))
    }
    for (y in seq_len(n_row)) {
      cy <- y0 + (y-1)*cell_h + cell_h/2 + 4
      cells <- c(cells, sprintf(
        '<text x="%.0f" y="%.0f" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="%s" font-family="system-ui">%d</text>',
        pad_x - 6, cy, fg, y))
    }

    # Vasi
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(md))) {
      uid  <- md$unit[i]
      trt  <- md$treatment[i]
      sel  <- uid %in% selected_units
      col  <- trt_colors[trt]
      fill <- if (sel) col else "#D1D5DB"
      strk <- if (sel) col else "#9CA3AF"
      lbl  <- label_color(col, bg)
      x_svg <- pad_x + (md$posX[i]-1)*cell_w + 3
      y_svg <- y0 + (md$posY[i]-1)*cell_h + 3
      safe_id <- gsub(":", "_", uid)
      cells <- c(cells, sprintf(
        '<rect class="vaso%s" id="v_%s" x="%.0f" y="%.0f" width="%.0f" height="%.0f"
         rx="%d" fill="%s" stroke="%s" stroke-width="2.5" style="cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;"
         onclick="toggleVaso(\'%s\')"
         data-unit="%s" data-trt="%s" data-sel="%s" data-lbl="%s">
           <title>%s&#10;%s</title>
         </rect>',
        if (sel) " sel" else " excl",
        safe_id, x_svg, y_svg, cell_w-6, cell_h-6,
        rx, fill, strk,
        safe_id, uid, trt, if (sel) "1" else "0", lbl,
        uid, trt))
      # Mini etichetta unit
      cells <- c(cells, sprintf(
        '<text id="t_%s" class="vaso-lbl" x="%.0f" y="%.0f" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11"
         fill="%s" font-family="system-ui" style="pointer-events:none;font-weight:600;">%s</text>',
        safe_id, x_svg + (cell_w-6)/2, y_svg + (cell_h-6)/2 + 4,
        if (sel) lbl else "#9CA3AF",
        uid))
    }
    y_end <- y0 + n_row * cell_h
    y_top <- y_end + 16
  }
  # Legenda trattamenti: va a capo se non entra nella larghezza della mappa.
  # La larghezza del testo è stimata per eccesso (8 unità per carattere).
  trts      <- names(trt_colors)
  char_w    <- 8; swatch_w <- 20; gap_w <- 16; row_h <- 22
  max_chars <- max(4, floor((svg_w - 8 - swatch_w) / char_w))
  labels    <- ifelse(nchar(trts) > max_chars,
                      paste0(substr(trts, 1, max_chars - 1), "\u2026"), trts)
  item_w    <- swatch_w + nchar(labels) * char_w + gap_w
  rows <- list(); cur <- integer(0); cur_w <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(trts)) {
    if (length(cur) && cur_w + item_w[i] - gap_w > svg_w - 8) {
      rows <- c(rows, list(cur)); cur <- integer(0); cur_w <- 0
    }
    cur <- c(cur, i); cur_w <- cur_w + item_w[i]
  }
  rows  <- c(rows, list(cur))
  svg_h <- y_end + 16 + legend_h + 24 + (length(rows) - 1) * row_h

  for (r in seq_along(rows)) {
    idx <- rows[[r]]
    lx  <- max(4, (svg_w - (sum(item_w[idx]) - gap_w)) / 2)
    ly  <- y_end + 14 + (r - 1) * row_h
    for (i in idx) {
      cells <- c(cells, sprintf(
        '<rect x="%.0f" y="%.0f" width="14" height="14" rx="3" fill="%s"/>
         <text x="%.0f" y="%.0f" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="%s" font-family="system-ui">%s<title>%s</title></text>',
        lx, ly, trt_colors[trts[i]], lx + swatch_w, ly + 11, fg,
        htmltools::htmlEscape(labels[i]), htmltools::htmlEscape(trts[i])))
      lx <- lx + item_w[i]
    }
  }

  sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" width="100%%" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="background:%s;border-radius:8px;display:block;">%s</svg>',
          svg_w, svg_h + 4, bg, paste(cells, collapse=""))
}

# ── Grafico temporale ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_time_chart <- function(trt_day_df, params, trt_colors, show_ribbon = TRUE,
                             ylab = "Mean value") {
  n_p   <- length(params)
  n_col <- 2; n_row <- ceiling(n_p / n_col)
  par(bg="#FFFFFF", col.axis="#1A1A1A", col.lab="#1A1A1A", col.main="#1A1A1A",
      fg="#1A1A1A", font.main=2, cex.main=1.35, cex.lab=1.2, cex.axis=1.1)
  if (n_p > 1) {
    par(mfrow=c(n_row, n_col), mar=c(7.5, 6, 3, 1.5), mgp=c(4, 0.9, 0))
  } else {
    par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(7.5, 6, 3, 1.5), mgp=c(4, 0.9, 0))
  }

  trts      <- intersect(names(trt_colors), unique(trt_day_df$treatment))
  trts      <- trts[order(trts)]
  all_dates <- sort(unique(trt_day_df$date))
  date_ticks <- pretty(all_dates)
  date_ticks <- date_ticks[date_ticks >= min(all_dates) & date_ticks <= max(all_dates)]
  if (!length(date_ticks)) date_ticks <- all_dates

  for (p in params) {
    sub <- trt_day_df[trt_day_df$param == p, , drop=FALSE]
    if (!nrow(sub)) next

    if (!any(is.finite(sub$mean))) next
    # Taglio a 0 solo per variabili non negative (indici come PSRI possono essere < 0)
    nonneg <- all(sub$mean >= 0, na.rm=TRUE)
    ylim <- range(sub$mean + sub$se, sub$mean - sub$se, na.rm=TRUE)
    if (nonneg) ylim[1] <- max(0, ylim[1])
    if (diff(ylim) == 0) ylim <- ylim + c(-0.5, 0.5) * max(abs(ylim[1]), 1)
    ylim <- ylim + diff(ylim) * c(-0.05, 0.08)

    unit_m <- param_unit(p)

    plot.new()
    plot.window(xlim=range(all_dates), ylim=ylim)
    rect(par("usr")[1], par("usr")[3], par("usr")[2], par("usr")[4],
         col="#FFFFFF", border=NA)
    abline(h=pretty(ylim), col="#E5E5E5", lwd=0.9)
    abline(v=date_ticks, col="#F0F0F0", lwd=0.7)

    for (trt in trts) {
      d <- sub[sub$treatment==trt, ]
      if (!nrow(d)) next
      d <- d[order(d$date),]
      col <- trt_colors[trt]
      if (show_ribbon) {
        rib_col <- adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=0.18)
        polygon(c(d$date, rev(d$date)),
                c(d$mean + d$se, rev(if (nonneg) pmax(d$mean - d$se, 0) else d$mean - d$se)),
                col=rib_col, border=NA)
      }
      lines(d$date, d$mean, col=col, lwd=2.2)
      # Con un solo giorno non esiste una linea né una banda: punto e barra di SE
      if (nrow(d) == 1) {
        if (show_ribbon && isTRUE(d$se > 0)) {
          lo <- if (nonneg) max(d$mean - d$se, 0) else d$mean - d$se
          segments(d$date, lo, d$date, d$mean + d$se, col=col, lwd=2.2)
        }
        points(d$date, d$mean, col=col, pch=19, cex=1.3)
      }
    }

    axis(2, las=1, cex.axis=1.1, col="#1A1A1A", col.axis="#1A1A1A",
         mgp=c(4, 0.9, 0))
    box(col="#1A1A1A", lwd=1)

    # Etichette asse X ruotate di 30 gradi
    usr <- par("usr")
    y_off <- (usr[4] - usr[3]) * 0.03
    text(x=date_ticks, y=usr[3] - y_off,
         labels=format(date_ticks, "%d %b"),
         srt=30, adj=c(1,1), xpd=TRUE, cex=1.0, col="#1A1A1A")

    # Asse Y: nome parametro + unità
    ylab_full <- if (nchar(unit_m) > 0) paste0(ylab, " [", trimws(unit_m), "]") else ylab
    title(main=p, col.main="#1A1A1A")
    title(ylab=ylab_full, col.lab="#1A1A1A")

    # Legenda solo nel primo pannello, testo e simboli più grandi
    if (p == params[1]) {
      n_lab <- vapply(trts, function(tr) {
        nv <- trt_day_df$n[trt_day_df$treatment == tr & trt_day_df$param == p]
        if (!length(nv)) "" else if (min(nv) == max(nv)) paste0(" (n=", max(nv), ")")
        else paste0(" (n=", min(nv), "-", max(nv), ")")
      }, "")
      legend("topleft", legend=paste0(trts, n_lab), col=trt_colors[trts], lwd=2.5,
             bty="n", cex=1.05, pt.cex=1.5)
    }
  }
  par(mfrow=c(1,1))
}

# ── Boxplot per data singola ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_boxplot_day <- function(daily_df, params, trt_colors, selected_date,
                              ylab = "Value", show_jitter = FALSE) {
  sub <- daily_df[daily_df$date == selected_date, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(sub)) return(invisible(NULL))

  n_p   <- length(params)
  n_col <- 2; n_row <- ceiling(n_p / n_col)
  par(bg="#FFFFFF", col.axis="#1A1A1A", col.lab="#1A1A1A", col.main="#1A1A1A",
      fg="#1A1A1A", font.main=2, cex.main=1.3, cex.lab=1.2, cex.axis=1.1)
  if (n_p > 1) {
    par(mfrow=c(n_row, n_col), mar=c(7, 6, 3.5, 1.5), mgp=c(4, 0.9, 0))
  } else {
    par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(7, 6, 3.5, 1.5), mgp=c(4, 0.9, 0))
  }
  trts <- intersect(names(trt_colors), unique(sub$treatment))
  trts <- trts[order(trts)]

  for (p in params) {
    vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub[[p]]))
    sub$val <- vals
    bp_data <- lapply(trts, function(trt) {
      v <- sub$val[sub$treatment == trt]
      v[!is.na(v)]
    })
    names(bp_data) <- trts
    non_empty <- sapply(bp_data, length) > 0
    bp_data <- bp_data[non_empty]
    cols    <- trt_colors[names(bp_data)]

    unit_m   <- param_unit(p)
    ylab_full <- if (nchar(unit_m) > 0) paste0(ylab, " [", trimws(unit_m), "]") else ylab

    all_vals <- unlist(bp_data); all_vals <- all_vals[!is.na(all_vals)]
    if (!length(all_vals)) next
    ylim <- range(all_vals)
    pad  <- if (diff(ylim) > 0) diff(ylim) * 0.06 else max(abs(ylim[1]) * 0.05, 0.5)
    ylim <- ylim + c(-pad, pad)

    plot.new()
    plot.window(xlim=c(0.5, length(bp_data)+0.5), ylim=ylim)
    rect(par("usr")[1], par("usr")[3], par("usr")[2], par("usr")[4],
         col="#FFFFFF", border=NA)
    y_major <- pretty(ylim)
    y_major <- y_major[y_major >= ylim[1] & y_major <= ylim[2]]
    abline(h=y_major, col="#E5E5E5", lwd=0.9)

    bp_pos <- seq_along(bp_data)
    boxplot(bp_data, add=TRUE, at=bp_pos, col=cols,
            border="#1A1A1A", lwd=1, axes=FALSE,
            outline=TRUE, pch=19, cex=0.6,
            whisklty=1, staplelwd=1.2, boxwex=0.55)

    if (show_jitter) {
      for (j in seq_along(bp_data)) {
        vals_j <- bp_data[[j]]
        if (!length(vals_j)) next
        jx <- bp_pos[j] + runif(length(vals_j), -0.18, 0.18)
        points(jx, vals_j, pch=21,
               bg=adjustcolor("#1A1A1A", alpha.f=0.35),
               col=adjustcolor("#1A1A1A", alpha.f=0.55),
               cex=0.85, lwd=0.6)
      }
    }

    usr <- par("usr")
    y_off <- (usr[4] - usr[3]) * 0.04
    text(x=bp_pos, y=usr[3] - y_off,
         labels=paste0(names(bp_data), " (n=", lengths(bp_data), ")"),
         srt=30, adj=c(1,1), xpd=TRUE, cex=0.95, col="#1A1A1A")

    axis(2, at=y_major, col="#1A1A1A", col.axis="#1A1A1A", cex.axis=1.1,
         las=1, mgp=c(4,0.9,0))
    box(col="#1A1A1A", lwd=1)
    title(main=paste0(p, "  [", format(selected_date, "%d %b %Y"), "]"),
          col.main="#1A1A1A")
    title(ylab=ylab_full, col.lab="#1A1A1A")
  }
  par(mfrow=c(1,1))
}

# ── Pivot long ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pivot_long_pe <- function(df, params) {
  id_cols    <- c("unit","timestamp","date","treatment","sensor","genotype","posX","posY","n_scans")
  id_present <- id_cols[id_cols %in% colnames(df)]
  id_data    <- df[, id_present, drop=FALSE]
  long_rows  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(params, function(p) {
    tmp <- id_data; tmp$parameter <- p; tmp$value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[p]])); tmp
  }))
  long_rows[order(rep(seq_len(nrow(df)), length(params))),]
}

# ── Base64 encoder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base64_encode_raw <- function(raw_bytes) {
  alphabet <- strsplit("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/","")[[1]]
  n <- length(raw_bytes); pad <- (3-n%%3)%%3
  if (pad>0) raw_bytes <- c(raw_bytes, raw(pad))
  m   <- matrix(as.integer(raw_bytes), nrow=3)
  idx <- rbind(bitwShiftR(m[1,],2),
               bitwOr(bitwShiftL(bitwAnd(m[1,],3L),4), bitwShiftR(m[2,],4)),
               bitwOr(bitwShiftL(bitwAnd(m[2,],15L),2), bitwShiftR(m[3,],6)),
               bitwAnd(m[3,],63L))
  out <- matrix(alphabet[idx+1], nrow=4)
  if (pad>=1) out[4,ncol(out)] <- "="
  if (pad==2) out[3,ncol(out)] <- "="
  paste(out, collapse="")
}

# ── Serializza vettore R in array JS (per slider date) ───────────────────────
jsonlite_like_array_r <- function(x) {
  esc <- gsub('"', '\\\\"', as.character(x))
  paste0("[", paste0('"', esc, '"', collapse=","), "]")
}

csv_field <- function(x, sep) {
  x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  need <- grepl(paste0("[", sep, "\"\r\n]"), x)
  x[need] <- paste0('"', gsub('"', '""', x[need], fixed = TRUE), '"')
  x
}
df_to_csv_string <- function(df, sep=",") {
  cols <- lapply(df, function(col) {
    if (inherits(col, "Date")) col <- format(col, "%Y-%m-%d")
    csv_field(col, sep)
  })
  header <- paste(csv_field(names(df), sep), collapse = sep)
  body   <- if (nrow(df)) do.call(paste, c(unname(cols), sep = sep)) else character(0)
  paste(c(header, body), collapse = "\n")
}

# renderTable mostrerebbe le date come numeri (giorni dal 1970)
fmt_dates <- function(df) {
  for (c in names(df)) if (inherits(df[[c]], "Date")) df[[c]] <- format(df[[c]], "%Y-%m-%d")
  df
}

tr_error <- function(msg, tx) {
  if (startsWith(msg, "ERR_COLS|")) return(tx$err_cols(sub("^ERR_COLS\\|", "", msg)))
  switch(msg, ERR_DATE = tx$err_date, ERR_UNIT = tx$err_unit,
         ERR_NOSEL = tx$chart_no_trt, ERR_NODATA = tx$err_nodata,
         ERR_NOPARAM = tx$err_noparam, ERR_TOOMANY = tx$err_toomany(MAX_CHART_PARAMS),
         ERR_EXPORT = tx$err_export, msg)
}

get_available_chart_params <- function(df, selected_params) {
  cand <- selected_params[selected_params %in% colnames(df)]
  cand[vapply(cand, function(c) !all(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[c]])))), logical(1))]
}

# Parametri da disegnare. NULL = nessuna scelta ancora fatta: solo i principali,
# perché i bin di distribuzione possono essere decine. character(0) = l'utente
# li ha deselezionati tutti, e quella scelta va rispettata.
resolve_chart_params <- function(chart_params, avail, main) {
  if (!is.null(chart_params)) return(intersect(avail, chart_params))
  m <- intersect(avail, main)
  if (length(m)) m else avail
}

# Disegna un grafico su file: stesse dimensioni per tutti i formati.
# spec = list(fun = funzione di disegno, args = i suoi argomenti).
render_chart_file <- function(spec, path, device = "png") {
  n_p   <- length(spec$args$params)
  n_col <- if (n_p > 1) 2 else 1
  w <- 5.5 * n_col
  h <- 5 * ceiling(n_p / n_col)
  # pdf con codifica WinAnsi: copre accenti, µ, ² e il simbolo dell'euro
  before <- dev.cur()
  suppressWarnings(switch(device,
    png = png(path, width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 300),
    pdf = pdf(path, width = w, height = h, useDingbats = FALSE, encoding = "WinAnsi"),
    svg = svg(path, width = w, height = h)))
  # Senza cairo svg() non apre alcun device e avvisa soltanto
  if (dev.cur() == before) stop("ERR_EXPORT", call. = FALSE)
  tryCatch(do.call(spec$fun, spec$args), finally = dev.off())
  invisible(path)
}

chart_to_b64 <- function(spec, device = "png") {
  f <- tempfile(fileext = paste0(".", device))
  on.exit(unlink(f))
  render_chart_file(spec, f, device)
  base64_encode_raw(readBin(f, "raw", file.info(f)$size))
}

CHART_MIME <- c(png = "image/png", pdf = "application/pdf", svg = "image/svg+xml")

# Un PNG non mostra quali vasi sono stati usati: va segnalato se la mappa è cambiata
png_is_stale <- function(png_units, selected_units) !setequal(png_units, selected_units)

# Oltre 42 pannelli (21 righe da 1500 px) il PNG supera il limite di 32767 px e
# png() si ferma con "unable to start device".
MAX_CHART_PARAMS <- 40
chart_params_error <- function(params) {
  if (!length(params)) "ERR_NOPARAM"
  else if (length(params) > MAX_CHART_PARAMS) "ERR_TOOMANY"
  else NULL
}

    /* ── dark mode ── */
    body.dark, body.dark html { background:#141A13 !important; color:#D8E8D5 !important; }
    body.dark .sx-card { background:#1E261D; border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .app-title { color:#E8F4E5; }
    body.dark .app-subtitle { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .section-label { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .section-divider { border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .badge-idle  { background:#253023; color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .badge-ok    { background:#1A3D22; color:#6FCF7F; }
    body.dark .badge-error { background:#3D1A1A; color:#F87171; }
    body.dark .lang-switcher { border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .lang-btn { background:#1E261D; color:#7A9975; border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .lang-btn.active { background:#3A6B35; color:#fff; }
    body.dark .lang-btn:hover:not(.active) { background:#253023; color:#D8E8D5; }
    body.dark .privacy-banner { background:#1A2D1A; border-color:#2A4A2A; }
    body.dark .privacy-title { color:#6FCF7F; }
    body.dark .privacy-body  { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .col-toggle { background:#1E261D; border-color:#334430; color:#C5D8C2; }
    body.dark .col-toggle.active { border-color:#5A9B55; background:#1E3A1A; color:#A8E0A0; }
    body.dark .col-toggle.excluded { background:#161E15; color:#4A5E47; }
    body.dark .link-btn { color:#6FCF7F; }
    body.dark #clean_btn { background:#3A6B35; }
    body.dark #chart_btn { background:#0E7490; }
    body.dark .dl-wrap .btn { border-color:#5A9B55; color:#6FCF7F; }
    body.dark .dl-wrap .btn:hover { background:#1E3A1A; }
    body.dark .stats-strip { background:#1A2D1A; border-color:#2A4A2A; }
    body.dark .stat-val { color:#6FCF7F; }
    body.dark .stat-lbl { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .preview-wrap { border-color:#334430; background:#1E261D; }
    body.dark .preview-wrap thead th { background:#253023; color:#C5D8C2; border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .preview-wrap tbody td { background:#1E261D; color:#B8D0B5; border-color:#2A3528; }
    body.dark .map-hint { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark #example_btn { color:#6FCF7F; }
    /* Il nome del file dopo il cambio lingua è un placeholder: deve restare leggibile */
    body.dark .shiny-input-container input[readonly]::placeholder { color:#A8BFA4; opacity:1; }
    body.dark .palette-lbl { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .palette-card { background:#1E261D; border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .palette-card.active { border-color:#22B8CF; background:#122A30; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #22B8CF; }
    body.dark .palette-title { color:#67E8F9; }
    body.dark .palette-sub { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .err-box { background:#3D1A1A; border-color:#7F1D1D; color:#FCA5A5; }
    body.dark .warn-box { background:#3A2E12; border-color:#78590F; color:#FCD34D; }
    body.dark .note-line { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .map-stat-sel  { color:#6FCF7F; }
    body.dark .map-stat-excl { color:#5A6B58; }
    body.dark .pivot-toggle { background:#1E261D; border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .pivot-toggle:hover, body.dark .pivot-toggle.on { border-color:#7C3AED; background:#1E1A2D; }
    body.dark .pivot-switch { background:#334430; }
    body.dark .pivot-label { color:#D8E8D5; }
    body.dark .pivot-sub   { color:#7A9975; }
    body.dark .chart-param-toggle { background:#1E261D; border-color:#334430; color:#C5D8C2; }
    body.dark .chart-param-toggle.active { border-color:#22B8CF; background:#122A30; color:#67E8F9; }
    body.dark .chart-param-toggle.excluded { background:#161E15; color:#4A5E47; }
    body.dark .chart-wrap { background:#1E261D; border-color:#334430; }
    body.dark .shiny-table-output table, body.dark table.table, body.dark table { background:#1E261D !important; color:#B8D0B5 !important; }
    body.dark table.table > :not(caption) > * > * { background:#1E261D !important; color:#B8D0B5 !important; }
    body.dark .form-control, body.dark input[type=text] { background:#253023 !important; border-color:#334430 !important; color:#D8E8D5 !important; }
  "))),

  tags$script(HTML("
    (function() {
      function sendHeight() {
        var h = document.body.scrollHeight;
        window.parent.postMessage({type:'cleanspex-resize', height:h}, '*');
      }
      var ro = new ResizeObserver(function() { sendHeight(); });
      ro.observe(document.body);
      var mo = new MutationObserver(function() { sendHeight(); });
      mo.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true, attributes:true});
      sendHeight();
      [100,300,600,1000,2000].forEach(function(ms){ setTimeout(sendHeight,ms); });
    })();

    (function() {
      var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
      function applyDark(on) {
        document.body.classList.toggle('dark', on);
        if (window.Shiny && Shiny.setInputValue) Shiny.setInputValue('dark_mode', on);
      }
      applyDark(mq.matches);
      mq.addEventListener('change', function(e) { applyDark(e.matches); });
      $(document).on('shiny:connected', function() { Shiny.setInputValue('dark_mode', mq.matches); });
    })();

    function setLang(lang) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(function(b) {
        b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-lang')===lang);
      });
      Shiny.setInputValue('ui_lang', lang, {priority:'event'});
    }

    function toggleCol(el) {
      el.classList.toggle('active'); el.classList.toggle('excluded');
      updateColMeta();
    }
    function setAllCols(mode) {
      if (mode==='main') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.col-toggle').forEach(function(el) {
          var isDist = el.classList.contains('dist');
          el.classList.toggle('active', !isDist);
          el.classList.toggle('excluded', isDist);
        });
      } else if (mode==='all') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.col-toggle').forEach(function(el) {
          el.classList.add('active'); el.classList.remove('excluded');
        });
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.col-toggle').forEach(function(el) {
          el.classList.remove('active'); el.classList.add('excluded');
        });
      }
      updateColMeta();
    }
    function updateColMeta() {
      var sel=[];
      document.querySelectorAll('.col-toggle.active').forEach(function(t){ sel.push(t.getAttribute('data-col')); });
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_params', sel, {priority:'event'});
      var cnt = document.getElementById('col-count-active');
      if (cnt) cnt.textContent = sel.length;
    }

    function toggleVaso(safe_id) {
      var el = document.getElementById('v_'+safe_id);
      if (!el) return;
      var cur = el.getAttribute('data-sel');
      var newSel = cur==='1' ? '0' : '1';
      el.setAttribute('data-sel', newSel);
      if (newSel==='1') {
        el.setAttribute('fill', el.getAttribute('data-col')||el.getAttribute('fill'));
        el.setAttribute('stroke', el.getAttribute('data-col')||el.getAttribute('fill'));
        el.classList.remove('excl'); el.classList.add('sel');
      } else {
        el.setAttribute('fill', '#D1D5DB');
        el.setAttribute('stroke', '#9CA3AF');
        el.classList.remove('sel'); el.classList.add('excl');
      }
      setVasoLabel(safe_id, newSel==='1');
      var selected=[];
      document.querySelectorAll('.vaso.sel').forEach(function(v){ selected.push(v.getAttribute('data-unit')); });
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_units', selected, {priority:'event'});
      updateMapStats();
    }
    function setVasoLabel(safe_id, on) {
      var lab = document.getElementById('t_'+safe_id);
      var pot = document.getElementById('v_'+safe_id);
      if (lab) lab.setAttribute('fill', on ? (pot.getAttribute('data-lbl') || '#FFFFFF') : '#9CA3AF');
    }
    function selectAllVasos() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.vaso').forEach(function(el) {
        el.setAttribute('data-sel','1');
        el.setAttribute('fill', el.getAttribute('data-col')||el.getAttribute('fill'));
        el.setAttribute('stroke', el.getAttribute('data-col')||el.getAttribute('fill'));
        el.classList.remove('excl'); el.classList.add('sel');
        setVasoLabel(el.id.substring(2), true);
      });
      var selected=[];
      document.querySelectorAll('.vaso.sel').forEach(function(v){ selected.push(v.getAttribute('data-unit')); });
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_units', selected, {priority:'event'});
      updateMapStats();
    }
    function deselectAllVasos() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.vaso').forEach(function(el) {
        el.setAttribute('data-sel','0');
        el.setAttribute('fill','#D1D5DB');
        el.setAttribute('stroke','#9CA3AF');
        el.classList.remove('sel'); el.classList.add('excl');
        setVasoLabel(el.id.substring(2), false);
      });
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_units', [], {priority:'event'});
      updateMapStats();
    }
    function updateMapStats() {
      var n_sel  = document.querySelectorAll('.vaso.sel').length;
      var n_excl = document.querySelectorAll('.vaso.excl').length;
      var el_sel  = document.getElementById('map-stat-sel');
      var el_excl = document.getElementById('map-stat-excl');
      if (el_sel)  el_sel.textContent  = n_sel;
      if (el_excl) el_excl.textContent = n_excl;
    }

    function togglePivot() {
      var el=document.getElementById('pivot-toggle');
      var on=el.classList.toggle('on');
      Shiny.setInputValue('pivot_long', on, {priority:'event'});
    }
    function toggleRibbon() {
      var el=document.getElementById('ribbon-toggle');
      var on=el.classList.toggle('on');
      Shiny.setInputValue('show_ribbon', on, {priority:'event'});
    }
    function toggleJitterBox() {
      var el=document.getElementById('jitter-box-toggle');
      var on=el.classList.toggle('on');
      Shiny.setInputValue('show_jitter_box', on, {priority:'event'});
    }
    function toggleChartParam(el) {
      el.classList.toggle('active'); el.classList.toggle('excluded');
      var sel=[];
      document.querySelectorAll('.chart-param-toggle.active').forEach(function(t){ sel.push(t.getAttribute('data-param')); });
      Shiny.setInputValue('chart_params', sel, {priority:'event'});
    }

    Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('downloadCSV', function(msg) {
      var blob=new Blob([msg.content],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
      var link=document.createElement('a'); link.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      link.download=msg.filename; document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link);
    });
    Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('downloadFile', function(msg) {
      var link=document.createElement('a'); link.href='data:'+msg.mime+';base64,'+msg.data;
      link.download=msg.filename; document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link);
    });
    $(document).on('shiny:value', function(e) {
      if (e.name==='col_selector_panel') setTimeout(updateColMeta, 50);
      if (e.name==='map_panel') setTimeout(updateMapStats, 100);
    });
  ")),

  # ── Header ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  div(class="sx-card",
    div(style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;",
      div(div(class="app-title","CleanSpeX 🧹"), uiOutput("app_subtitle")),
      div(style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;",
        uiOutput("status_badge"),
        div(class="lang-switcher",
          tags$button(class="lang-btn", `data-lang`="it", onclick="setLang('it')", "IT"),
          tags$button(class="lang-btn active", `data-lang`="en", onclick="setLang('en')", "EN"),
          tags$button(class="lang-btn", `data-lang`="es", onclick="setLang('es')", "ES"),
          tags$button(class="lang-btn", `data-lang`="fr", onclick="setLang('fr')", "FR")
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  uiOutput("privacy_banner"),
  uiOutput("step1_panel"),
  uiOutput("col_selector_panel"),
  uiOutput("step3_panel"),
  uiOutput("map_panel"),
  uiOutput("chart_panel"),
  uiOutput("box_panel"),
  uiOutput("final_panel"),

  hr(class="section-divider"),
  div(style="text-align:center;font-size:.92rem;color:#6B7280;padding:.5rem 0 1.5rem;",
    uiOutput("app_credits"))
)

# ── Server ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  rv <- reactiveValues(
    df_raw=NULL, df_daily=NULL, df_final=NULL,
    params=NULL, trt_colors=NULL, map_df=NULL,
    error=NULL, error_step=NULL, base_name=NULL, file_name=NULL,
    chart_png_b64=NULL, chart_png_box=NULL, chart_units=NULL, box_units=NULL,
    chart_spec=NULL, box_spec=NULL,  # ultimo grafico disegnato, riusato per PDF e SVG
    # Stato delle scelte dell'utente, conservato quando i pannelli vengono
    # ridisegnati (cambio lingua, dark mode, rielaborazione)
    sel_units=NULL, sel_params=NULL, chart_params=NULL,
    date_range=NULL, box_idx=NULL, multi_sensor=FALSE,
    load_notes=NULL, nonnum=NULL,
    is_example=FALSE, example_n=0L, palette=DEFAULT_PALETTE
  )
  set_err <- function(step, msg) { rv$error <- msg; rv$error_step <- step }

  lang <- reactive({ if (is.null(input$ui_lang)) "en" else input$ui_lang })
  t    <- reactive({ TR[[lang()]] })

  observeEvent(input$selected_units, {
    new_units <- unlist(input$selected_units)
    # Il file finale già generato non rispecchierebbe più la mappa. La mappa
    # rimanda la selezione a ogni ridisegno: conta solo se è davvero cambiata.
    if (!setequal(new_units, rv$sel_units)) rv$df_final <- NULL
    rv$sel_units <- new_units
    if (length(rv$sel_units) && identical(rv$error, "ERR_NOSEL")) rv$error <- NULL
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$pivot_long, { rv$df_final <- NULL }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  # La mappa cambia subito; i grafici già generati restano finché non li rigeneri
  observeEvent(input$palette, {
    rv$palette <- input$palette
    if (!is.null(rv$df_raw)) rv$trt_colors <- make_trt_colors(rv$df_raw$treatment, rv$palette)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  # Solo gli errori dello stesso passo: la selezione dello step 2 viene rimandata
  # anche al cambio lingua e non deve cancellare un errore dei grafici
  clear_param_err <- function(sel, steps) {
    if (length(sel) && isTRUE(rv$error %in% c("ERR_NOPARAM", "ERR_TOOMANY")) &&
        isTRUE(rv$error_step %in% steps)) rv$error <- NULL
  }
  observeEvent(input$selected_params, {
    rv$sel_params <- unlist(input$selected_params)
    clear_param_err(rv$sel_params, "clean")
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$chart_params, {
    # character(0), non NULL: "ho deselezionato tutto" è diverso da "non ho ancora scelto"
    rv$chart_params <- as.character(unlist(input$chart_params))
    clear_param_err(rv$chart_params, c("chart", "box"))
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(list(input$range_start_idx, input$range_end_idx), {
    if (!is.null(input$range_start_idx) && !is.null(input$range_end_idx))
      rv$date_range <- c(input$range_start_idx, input$range_end_idx)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$box_date_idx, { rv$box_idx <- input$box_date_idx }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  for (st in c("load","clean","chart","box","final")) local({
    s <- st
    output[[paste0("err_", s)]] <- renderUI({
      req(rv$error, identical(rv$error_step, s))
      div(class="err-box", "\u26A0 ", tr_error(rv$error, t()))
    })
  })

  output$app_subtitle <- renderUI({
    tx <- t()
    tagList(
      p(class="app-subtitle", tx$app_subtitle, " ",
        tags$a(href="https://phenospex.com/products/plant-phenotyping/planteye-f600-multispectral-3d-scanner-for-plants/",
               target="_blank",
               style="color:#2D6A4F;font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;",
               "PlantEye — Phenospex."),
      p(class="app-subtitle", style="font-size:.92rem;color:#9CA3AF;margin-top:.1rem;",
        tx$app_descr)
    ))
  })
  output$privacy_banner <- renderUI({
    tx <- t()
    div(class="privacy-banner",
      div(class="privacy-icon","🔒"),
      div(div(class="privacy-title", tx$privacy_title),
          p(class="privacy-body", tx$privacy_body)))
  })
  output$app_credits <- renderUI({
    cr <- t()$credits
    tagList(cr$pre,
      tags$a(href="https://www.mauromaver.eu", target="_blank",
             style="color:#3A6B35;font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;","Mauro Maver"),
      " · ",
      tags$span(style="color:#9CA3AF;font-size:.88rem;", "v.1.2"),
      cr$bug,
      tags$a(href="https://github.com/Stramon1um", target="_blank",
             style="color:#3A6B35;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;","GitHub"),
      cr$or,
      tags$a(href="mailto:mauro.maver@univr.it",
             style="color:#3A6B35;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;", cr$mail),
      " \U0001F60A")
  })

  # ── Step 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$step1_panel <- renderUI({
    tx <- t()
    # Il pannello viene ridisegnato al cambio lingua e fileInput perderebbe il nome.
    # Ridisegno anche con i dati di esempio, che non passano da fileInput.
    rv$example_n
    fn <- isolate(rv$file_name)
    div(class="sx-card", p(class="section-label", tx$step1),
      fileInput("file_in", label=NULL, accept=c(".csv","text/csv"),
                placeholder=if (is.null(fn)) tx$file_ph else fn, buttonLabel=tx$file_btn),
      actionLink("example_btn", tx$example_btn, icon=icon("seedling")),
      uiOutput("file_info_chip"),
      uiOutput("err_load"))
  })

  load_data <- function(path, file_name, is_example = FALSE) {
    rv$file_name <- file_name
    rv$is_example <- is_example
    rv$chart_spec <- rv$box_spec <- NULL
    rv$df_raw <- rv$df_daily <- rv$df_final <- rv$params <- rv$trt_colors <-
      rv$map_df <- rv$error <- rv$error_step <- rv$chart_png_b64 <- rv$chart_png_box <- NULL
    rv$sel_units <- rv$sel_params <- rv$chart_params <- rv$date_range <- rv$box_idx <- NULL
    rv$multi_sensor <- FALSE
    rv$load_notes <- rv$nonnum <- NULL
    tryCatch({
      df <- parse_planteye(path)
      p  <- classify_params(df)
      rv$base_name  <- sub("\\.csv$","", file_name, ignore.case=TRUE)
      rv$params     <- p
      rv$sel_params <- p$main
      rv$trt_colors <- make_trt_colors(df$treatment, rv$palette)
      rv$load_notes <- attr(df, "pe_notes")
      md <- unique(df[, c("unit","treatment","posA","posX","posY")])
      rv$map_df     <- md[!duplicated(md$unit), , drop=FALSE]
      rv$sel_units  <- rv$map_df$unit
      if ("sensor" %in% names(df)) {
        ns <- tapply(df$sensor, paste(df$unit, df$date), function(x) length(unique(x[nzchar(x)])))
        rv$multi_sensor <- any(ns > 1, na.rm=TRUE)
      }
      rv$df_raw <- df
    }, error=function(e) set_err("load", conditionMessage(e)))
  }

  observeEvent(input$file_in, load_data(input$file_in$datapath, input$file_in$name))

  observeEvent(input$example_btn, {
    f <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
    writeLines(EXAMPLE_PLANTEYE, f)
    load_data(f, "example_planteye.csv", is_example = TRUE)
    unlink(f)
    rv$example_n <- rv$example_n + 1L
  })

  output$file_info_chip <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_raw)
    tx <- t()
    n_plants <- length(unique(rv$df_raw$unit))
    n_trts   <- length(unique(rv$df_raw$treatment))
    n_days   <- length(unique(rv$df_raw$date))
    nt <- rv$load_notes
    tagList(
      div(class="file-chip" ,
          style="display:inline-block;font-size:.78rem;background:#EAF4EF;border:1px solid #C6E8D6;border-radius:4px;padding:.2rem .6rem;color:#2D6A4F;font-weight:600;margin-top:.5rem;",
          tx$file_info(nrow(rv$df_raw), n_plants, n_trts, n_days)),
      if (rv$is_example) p(class="note-line", style="margin:.4rem 0 0;", tx$example_note),
      if (isTRUE(nt$bad_dates > 0)) div(class="warn-box", tx$note_bad_dates(nt$bad_dates)),
      if (isTRUE(nt$ambiguous))     div(class="warn-box", tx$note_ambig_dates)
    )
  })

  # ── Step 2: Selezione parametri ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$col_selector_panel <- renderUI({
    req(rv$params)
    tx <- t()
    p  <- rv$params
    sel <- isolate(rv$sel_params)
    pill <- function(col, dist) {
      tags$span(class=paste("col-toggle", if (dist) "dist", if (col %in% sel) "active" else "excluded"),
                `data-col`=col, onclick="toggleCol(this);", col)
    }
    pills_main <- lapply(p$main, pill, dist=FALSE)
    pills_dist <- lapply(p$dist, pill, dist=TRUE)

    div(class="sx-card", p(class="section-label", tx$step2),
      div(class="toggle-actions",
        tags$button(class="link-btn", onclick="setAllCols('main')", tx$sel_main),
        tags$button(class="link-btn", onclick="setAllCols('all')",  tx$sel_all),
        tags$button(class="link-btn", onclick="setAllCols('none')", tx$desel_all)
      ),
      div(class="col-grid", pills_main, pills_dist),
      p(style="font-size:.9rem;color:#6B7280;margin-top:.3rem;",
        span(id="col-count-active", length(intersect(sel, p$all))), " / ",
        length(p$all), " ", tx$col_meta)
    )
  })

  # ── Step 3: Pulizia + riepilogo ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$step3_panel <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_raw)
    tx <- t()
    div(class="sx-card", p(class="section-label", tx$step3),
      div(style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;",
        actionButton("clean_btn", tx$btn_process, icon=icon("gears"),
          style="border:none;color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;padding:.6rem 1.7rem;border-radius:6px;background:#2D6A4F;"),
        div(class="dl-wrap", uiOutput("dl_clean_ui"))
      ),
      uiOutput("err_clean"),
      uiOutput("summary_wrap")
    )
  })

  observeEvent(input$clean_btn, {
    req(rv$df_raw)
    rv$df_daily <- rv$df_final <- rv$chart_png_b64 <- rv$chart_png_box <- rv$error <- rv$nonnum <- NULL
    rv$chart_params <- rv$date_range <- rv$box_idx <- NULL
    tryCatch({
      sel <- rv$sel_params
      if (!length(sel)) stop("ERR_NOPARAM", call.=FALSE)
      dd <- daily_mean_per_plant(rv$df_raw, sel)
      if (!nrow(dd) || !length(get_available_chart_params(dd, sel))) stop("ERR_NODATA", call.=FALSE)
      rv$nonnum   <- count_non_numeric(rv$df_raw, sel)
      rv$df_daily <- dd
    }, error=function(e) set_err("clean", conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  output$dl_clean_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_daily)
    div(class="dl-wrap",
      actionButton("dl_clean_btn", t()$btn_dl_clean, icon=icon("download")))
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_clean_btn, {
    req(rv$df_daily)
    session$sendCustomMessage("downloadCSV", list(
      filename=paste0(rv$base_name, "_clean.csv"),
      content=df_to_csv_string(rv$df_daily)))
  })

  output$summary_wrap <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_daily)
    tx <- t()
    df <- rv$df_daily
    div(
      hr(class="section-divider"),
      div(class="stats-strip",
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", length(unique(df$unit))), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_plants)),
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", length(unique(df$treatment))), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_trts)),
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", length(unique(df$date))), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_days)),
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", length(setdiff(colnames(df), ID_COLS_DAILY))), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_params)),
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", paste0(rv$base_name,"_clean.csv")), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_file))
      ),
      p(class="note-line", tx$scans_note(min(df$n_scans), max(df$n_scans)),
        if (isTRUE(rv$multi_sensor)) tagList(" ", tx$sensor_note)),
      if (length(rv$nonnum)) div(class="warn-box", style="margin:0 0 1rem;",
        tx$nonnum_note(sum(rv$nonnum), names(rv$nonnum))),
      div(class="preview-wrap", tableOutput("preview_tbl"))
    )
  })
  output$preview_tbl <- renderTable({
    req(rv$df_daily)
    df <- rv$df_daily
    disp_cols <- c("unit","date","treatment","posX","posY","n_scans",
                   utils::head(setdiff(colnames(df), ID_COLS_DAILY), 4))
    fmt_dates(df[, disp_cols[disp_cols %in% colnames(df)], drop=FALSE])
  }, striped=FALSE, hover=TRUE, bordered=FALSE, spacing="xs", na="", digits=3)

  # ── Step 4: Mappa spaziale ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$map_panel <- renderUI({
    req(rv$map_df, rv$trt_colors)
    tx    <- t()
    mdf   <- rv$map_df
    sel   <- intersect(isolate(rv$sel_units), mdf$unit)
    is_dark <- isTRUE(input$dark_mode)
    svg_html <- make_bench_svg(mdf, rv$trt_colors,
                                selected_units = sel,
                                is_dark = is_dark, bench_label = tx$map_bench)
    js_arr <- function(x) paste0("[", paste0('"', x, '"', collapse=","), "]")
    pal_card <- function(name, title, sub) {
      tags$button(type="button", class=paste("palette-card", if (identical(name, rv$palette)) "active"),
        onclick=sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('palette', '%s', {priority:'event'});", name),
        div(class="palette-title", title),
        div(class="palette-sub", sub),
        div(class="palette-swatches", lapply(get_palette(name, 6), function(col)
          span(class="palette-swatch", style=paste0("background:", col, ";")))))
    }
    init_js <- tags$script(HTML(paste0(
      "setTimeout(function(){\n",
      paste(sprintf("  var e=document.getElementById('v_%s'); if(e) e.setAttribute('data-col','%s');",
                    gsub(":","_",mdf$unit), rv$trt_colors[mdf$treatment]), collapse="\n"),
      "\n  Shiny.setInputValue('selected_units',",
      if (length(sel)) js_arr(sel) else "[]",
      ",{priority:'event'});\n}, 200);"
    )))

    div(class="sx-card",
      p(class="section-label", tx$step4),
      p(class="map-hint", tx$map_hint),
      div(style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;",
        tags$button(class="link-btn", onclick="selectAllVasos()",   tx$btn_sel_all),
        tags$button(class="link-btn", onclick="deselectAllVasos()", tx$btn_desel_all)
      ),
      div(class="map-wrap", HTML(svg_html)),
      init_js,
      div(class="map-stats",
        span(class="map-stat-sel", id="map-stat-sel", length(sel)), " ", tx$map_selected, " · ",
        span(class="map-stat-excl", id="map-stat-excl", nrow(mdf) - length(sel)), " ", tx$map_excluded
      ),
      p(class="palette-lbl", tx$palette_lbl),
      div(class="palette-grid",
        pal_card("npg",   "NPG",            tx$palette_npg_sub),
        pal_card("okabe", "Okabe-Ito",      tx$palette_okabe_sub),
        pal_card("gray",  tx$palette_gray,  tx$palette_gray_sub)
      )
    )
  })

  # ── Step 5: Grafico temporale ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$chart_panel <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_daily)
    tx    <- t()
    df    <- rv$df_daily
    dates <- sort(unique(df$date))
    n     <- length(dates)
    avail <- get_available_chart_params(df, c(rv$params$main, rv$params$dist))
    if (!length(avail)) return(NULL)
    act <- resolve_chart_params(isolate(rv$chart_params), avail, rv$params$main)
    rg  <- isolate(rv$date_range); if (length(rg) != 2) rg <- c(1, n)
    r0  <- max(1, min(as.integer(rg[1]), n)); r1 <- max(1, min(as.integer(rg[2]), n))
    rib <- isolate(input$show_ribbon); rib_on <- is.null(rib) || isTRUE(rib)

    pills <- lapply(avail, function(p)
      tags$span(class=paste("chart-param-toggle", if (p %in% rv$params$dist) "dist",
                            if (p %in% act) "active" else "excluded"),
                `data-param`=p, onclick="toggleChartParam(this);", p))

    div(class="sx-card",
      p(class="section-label", tx$step5),
      p(style="font-size:.9rem;color:#6B7280;margin-bottom:1rem;", tx$chart_hint),
      p(style="font-size:.9rem;color:#6B7280;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.5rem;", tx$chart_param_lbl),
      div(class="chart-param-grid", pills),
      div(id="ribbon-toggle", class=if (rib_on) "pivot-toggle on" else "pivot-toggle", onclick="toggleRibbon();",
        div(class="pivot-switch"),
        div(div(class="pivot-label", tx$ribbon_label),
            div(class="pivot-sub",   tx$ribbon_sub))
      ),
      # ── Slicer date integrato ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      hr(class="section-divider", style="margin:.8rem 0;"),
      p(style="font-size:.9rem;color:#6B7280;margin-bottom:.8rem;", tx$range_hint),
      div(style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.2rem;margin-bottom:.8rem;",
        div(
          tags$label(style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:#6B7280;display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem;",
                     tx$range_start),
          tags$input(type="range", id="range_start_idx", min=1, max=n, value=r0, step=1,
                     style="width:100%;accent-color:#2D6A4F;", oninput="updateRangeLabel()")
        ),
        div(
          tags$label(style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:#6B7280;display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem;",
                     tx$range_end),
          tags$input(type="range", id="range_end_idx", min=1, max=n, value=r1, step=1,
                     style="width:100%;accent-color:#2D6A4F;", oninput="updateRangeLabel()")
        )
      ),
      div(style="font-size:.92rem;color:#374151;margin-bottom:1rem;background:#F3F4F6;border-radius:6px;padding:.5rem 1rem;display:inline-block;",
        span(id="range_label", paste(format(dates[min(r0,r1)],"%d %b %Y"), "→", format(dates[max(r0,r1)],"%d %b %Y")))
      ),
      tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
        var _dates_range = %s;
        function updateRangeLabel() {
          var i0 = parseInt(document.getElementById('range_start_idx').value)-1;
          var i1 = parseInt(document.getElementById('range_end_idx').value)-1;
          if (i0 > i1) { var tmp=i0; i0=i1; i1=tmp; }
          document.getElementById('range_label').textContent =
            _dates_range[i0] + ' \u2192 ' + _dates_range[i1];
          Shiny.setInputValue('range_start_idx', i0+1, {priority:'event'});
          Shiny.setInputValue('range_end_idx',   i1+1, {priority:'event'});
        }
        updateRangeLabel();
      ", jsonlite_like_array_r(format(dates, "%d %b %Y"))))),
      # ── Pulsanti ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      div(style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;",
        actionButton("chart_btn", tx$btn_chart, icon=icon("chart-line"),
          style="border:none;color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;padding:.6rem 1.7rem;border-radius:6px;background:#0E7490;"),
        uiOutput("dl_chart_ui"),
        uiOutput("clear_chart_ui")
      ),
      uiOutput("err_chart"),
      uiOutput("chart_render_wrap")
    )
  })

  observeEvent(input$chart_btn, {
    req(rv$df_daily, rv$trt_colors)
    rv$chart_png_b64 <- rv$error <- NULL
    sel_units <- rv$sel_units
    if (!length(sel_units)) { set_err("chart", "ERR_NOSEL"); return() }
    avail <- get_available_chart_params(rv$df_daily, c(rv$params$main, rv$params$dist))
    sel_params <- resolve_chart_params(rv$chart_params, avail, rv$params$main)
    sel_err <- chart_params_error(sel_params)
    if (!is.null(sel_err)) { set_err("chart", sel_err); return() }
    tryCatch({
      dates <- sort(unique(rv$df_daily$date))
      i0    <- max(1, min(as.integer(input$range_start_idx %||% 1),         length(dates)))
      i1    <- max(1, min(as.integer(input$range_end_idx   %||% length(dates)), length(dates)))
      if (i0 > i1) { tmp <- i0; i0 <- i1; i1 <- tmp }
      sub <- rv$df_daily[rv$df_daily$date %in% dates[i0:i1] & rv$df_daily$unit %in% sel_units,]
      trt_day <- agg_trt_day(sub, sel_params, unique(sub$unit))
      if (is.null(trt_day)||!nrow(trt_day)) stop("ERR_NODATA", call.=FALSE)
      sel_params <- sel_params[sel_params %in% trt_day$param]
      show_ribbon <- if (is.null(input$show_ribbon)) TRUE else isTRUE(input$show_ribbon)
      spec <- list(fun=draw_time_chart,
                   args=list(trt_day_df=trt_day, params=sel_params, trt_colors=rv$trt_colors,
                             show_ribbon=show_ribbon, ylab=t()$chart_ylab))
      rv$chart_png_b64 <- chart_to_b64(spec)
      rv$chart_spec  <- spec
      rv$chart_units <- sel_units
    }, error=function(e) set_err("chart", conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

  output$chart_render_wrap <- renderUI({
    req(rv$chart_png_b64)
    tagList(
      if (png_is_stale(rv$chart_units, rv$sel_units)) div(class="warn-box", id="chart-stale", t()$chart_stale),
      div(class="chart-wrap",
        tags$img(src=paste0("data:image/png;base64,", rv$chart_png_b64))))
  })
  # Pulsanti e download condivisi dal grafico temporale e dal boxplot.
  # PDF e SVG riusano la specifica del grafico mostrato, anche se nel frattempo
  # sono cambiate le opzioni: il file scaricato è sempre la figura a schermo.
  dl_buttons <- function(prefix) {
    tx <- t()
    div(class="dl-wrap", style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;",
      actionButton(paste0(prefix, "_png_btn"), tx$btn_dl_png, icon=icon("image")),
      actionButton(paste0(prefix, "_pdf_btn"), tx$btn_dl_pdf, icon=icon("file-pdf")),
      actionButton(paste0(prefix, "_svg_btn"), tx$btn_dl_svg, icon=icon("bezier-curve")))
  }
  send_chart <- function(ext, suffix, b64) {
    session$sendCustomMessage("downloadFile", list(
      filename=paste0(rv$base_name, "_", suffix, ".", ext),
      mime=CHART_MIME[[ext]], data=b64))
  }
  export_chart <- function(ext, spec, suffix, step) {
    rv$error <- NULL
    tryCatch(send_chart(ext, suffix, chart_to_b64(spec, ext)),
             error=function(e) set_err(step, conditionMessage(e)))
  }

  output$dl_chart_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$chart_png_b64)
    dl_buttons("dl_chart")
  })
  output$clear_chart_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$chart_png_b64)
    tags$button(class="link-btn", style="color:#9CA3AF;",
      onclick="Shiny.setInputValue('clear_chart', Math.random(), {priority:'event'});",
      icon("xmark"), " ", t()$btn_clear)
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_chart_png_btn, {
    req(rv$chart_png_b64)
    send_chart("png", "chart", rv$chart_png_b64)
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_chart_pdf_btn, {
    req(rv$chart_png_b64, rv$chart_spec)
    export_chart("pdf", rv$chart_spec, "chart", "chart")
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_chart_svg_btn, {
    req(rv$chart_png_b64, rv$chart_spec)
    export_chart("svg", rv$chart_spec, "chart", "chart")
  })
  observeEvent(input$clear_chart, { rv$chart_png_b64 <- NULL })

  # ── Step 5b: Boxplot su data singola ─────────────────────────────────────────
  output$box_panel <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_daily)
    tx    <- t()
    dates <- sort(unique(rv$df_daily$date))
    n     <- length(dates)
    mid   <- ceiling(n/2)
    bi    <- isolate(rv$box_idx)
    if (!is.null(bi)) mid <- max(1, min(as.integer(bi), n))
    jit_on <- isTRUE(isolate(input$show_jitter_box))

    div(class="sx-card",
      p(class="section-label", tx$box_title),
      p(style="font-size:.9rem;color:#6B7280;margin-bottom:1.2rem;", tx$box_hint),
      div(style="margin-bottom:.8rem;",
        tags$label(style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:#6B7280;display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem;",
                   tx$box_date_lbl),
        tags$input(type="range", id="box_date_idx", min=1, max=n, value=mid, step=1,
                   style="width:100%;max-width:500px;accent-color:#7C3AED;",
                   oninput="updateBoxLabel()")
      ),
      div(style="font-size:.92rem;color:#374151;margin-bottom:1rem;background:#F3F4F6;border-radius:6px;padding:.5rem 1rem;display:inline-block;",
        span(id="box_label", format(dates[mid], "%d %b %Y"))
      ),
      tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
        var _dates_box = %s;
        function updateBoxLabel() {
          var i = parseInt(document.getElementById('box_date_idx').value)-1;
          document.getElementById('box_label').textContent = _dates_box[i];
          Shiny.setInputValue('box_date_idx', i+1, {priority:'event'});
        }
        updateBoxLabel();
      ", jsonlite_like_array_r(format(dates, "%d %b %Y"))))),
      div(id="jitter-box-toggle", class=if (jit_on) "pivot-toggle on" else "pivot-toggle", onclick="toggleJitterBox();",
        div(class="pivot-switch"),
        div(div(class="pivot-label", tx$jitter_label),
            div(class="pivot-sub",   tx$jitter_sub))
      ),
      div(style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;",
        actionButton("box_chart_btn", tx$btn_box_chart, icon=icon("chart-bar"),
          style="border:none;color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;padding:.6rem 1.7rem;border-radius:6px;background:#7C3AED;"),
        uiOutput("dl_box_ui"),
        uiOutput("clear_box_ui")
      ),
      uiOutput("err_box"),
      uiOutput("box_chart_wrap")
    )
  })

  observeEvent(input$box_chart_btn, {
    req(rv$df_daily, rv$trt_colors)
    rv$chart_png_box <- rv$error <- NULL
    tryCatch({
      dates <- sort(unique(rv$df_daily$date))
      idx   <- max(1, min(as.integer(input$box_date_idx %||% ceiling(length(dates)/2)), length(dates)))
      sel_date  <- dates[idx]
      sel_units <- rv$sel_units
      if (!length(sel_units)) stop("ERR_NOSEL", call.=FALSE)
      sub <- rv$df_daily[rv$df_daily$unit %in% sel_units, , drop=FALSE]
      avail <- get_available_chart_params(rv$df_daily, c(rv$params$main, rv$params$dist))
      sel_params <- resolve_chart_params(rv$chart_params, avail, rv$params$main)
      sel_err <- chart_params_error(sel_params)
      if (!is.null(sel_err)) stop(sel_err, call.=FALSE)
      sel_params <- sel_params[vapply(sel_params, function(p)
        any(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub[[p]][sub$date == sel_date])))), logical(1))]
      if (!length(sel_params)) stop("ERR_NODATA", call.=FALSE)
      spec <- list(fun=draw_boxplot_day,
                   args=list(daily_df=sub, params=sel_params, trt_colors=rv$trt_colors,
                             selected_date=sel_date, ylab=t()$chart_ylab,
                             show_jitter=isTRUE(input$show_jitter_box)))
      rv$chart_png_box <- chart_to_b64(spec)
      rv$box_spec  <- spec
      rv$box_units <- sel_units
    }, error=function(e) set_err("box", conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  output$dl_box_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$chart_png_box)
    dl_buttons("dl_box")
  })
  output$clear_box_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$chart_png_box)
    tags$button(class="link-btn", style="color:#9CA3AF;",
      onclick="Shiny.setInputValue('clear_box', Math.random(), {priority:'event'});",
      icon("xmark"), " ", t()$btn_clear_box)
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_box_png_btn, {
    req(rv$chart_png_box)
    send_chart("png", "boxplot", rv$chart_png_box)
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_box_pdf_btn, {
    req(rv$chart_png_box, rv$box_spec)
    export_chart("pdf", rv$box_spec, "boxplot", "box")
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_box_svg_btn, {
    req(rv$chart_png_box, rv$box_spec)
    export_chart("svg", rv$box_spec, "boxplot", "box")
  })
  output$box_chart_wrap <- renderUI({
    req(rv$chart_png_box)
    tagList(
      if (png_is_stale(rv$box_units, rv$sel_units)) div(class="warn-box", id="box-stale", t()$chart_stale),
      div(class="chart-wrap",
        tags$img(src=paste0("data:image/png;base64,", rv$chart_png_box))))
  })
  observeEvent(input$clear_box, { rv$chart_png_box <- NULL })

  # ── Step 6: Export finale ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$final_panel <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_daily)
    tx <- t()
    div(class="sx-card", p(class="section-label", tx$step6),
      div(id="pivot-toggle", class=if (isTRUE(isolate(input$pivot_long))) "pivot-toggle on" else "pivot-toggle", onclick="togglePivot();",
        div(class="pivot-switch"),
        div(div(class="pivot-label", tx$pivot_label),
            div(class="pivot-sub",   tx$pivot_sub))
      ),
      div(style="display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;",
        actionButton("pivot_btn", tx$btn_final, icon=icon("file-csv"),
          style="border:none;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;padding:.58rem 1.6rem;border-radius:6px;background:#7C3AED;"),
        div(class="dl-wrap", uiOutput("dl_final_ui"))
      ),
      uiOutput("err_final"),
      uiOutput("final_preview_wrap")
    )
  })

  observeEvent(input$pivot_btn, {
    req(rv$df_daily)
    rv$df_final <- rv$error <- NULL
    tryCatch({
      sel_units <- rv$sel_units
      if (!length(sel_units)) stop("ERR_NOSEL", call.=FALSE)
      df <- rv$df_daily[rv$df_daily$unit %in% sel_units, , drop=FALSE]
      rownames(df) <- NULL
      sel_params <- setdiff(colnames(df), ID_COLS_DAILY)
      rv$df_final <- if (isTRUE(input$pivot_long)) pivot_long_pe(df, sel_params) else df
    }, error=function(e) set_err("final", conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  output$dl_final_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_final)
    div(class="dl-wrap", actionButton("dl_final_btn", t()$btn_dl_final, icon=icon("download")))
  })
  observeEvent(input$dl_final_btn, {
    req(rv$df_final)
    session$sendCustomMessage("downloadCSV", list(
      filename=paste0(rv$base_name,"_final.csv"),
      content=df_to_csv_string(rv$df_final)))
  })

  output$final_preview_wrap <- renderUI({
    req(rv$df_final)
    tx <- t()
    tagList(
      hr(class="section-divider"),
      div(class="stats-strip",
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", nrow(rv$df_final)), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_rows)),
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", length(setdiff(colnames(rv$df_daily), ID_COLS_DAILY))), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_params)),
        div(class="stat-item", span(class="stat-val", if(isTRUE(input$pivot_long))"long" else "wide"), span(class="stat-lbl", tx$stat_format))
      ),
      p(class="section-label", tx$final_preview),
      div(class="preview-wrap", tableOutput("final_preview_tbl"))
    )
  })
  output$final_preview_tbl <- renderTable({
    req(rv$df_final); fmt_dates(rv$df_final)
  }, striped=FALSE, hover=TRUE, bordered=FALSE, spacing="xs", na="", digits=3)

  # ── Badge stato ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$status_badge <- renderUI({
    tx <- t()
    if (!is.null(rv$error))         div(class="status-badge badge-error", tx$status_error)
    else if (!is.null(rv$df_final)) div(class="status-badge badge-ok",   tx$status_final)
    else if (!is.null(rv$chart_png_b64)) div(class="status-badge badge-ok", tx$status_chart)
    else if (!is.null(rv$df_daily)) div(class="status-badge badge-ok",   tx$status_clean)
    else if (!is.null(rv$df_raw))   div(class="status-badge badge-ok",   tx$status_loaded)
    else                             div(class="status-badge badge-idle", tx$status_waiting)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
